pages.title: Bellybutton Lint
pages.text: One of the 16 CD Player songs, and the only one without the palm-muted guitar chug: its guitars are chords and pads. The Genesis Temple's retrospective names it the writer's favourite. Skitchin' (EA, 1994), Mega Drive / Genesis. Music by Jeff van Dyck.

pages.title: Bad reviews
pages.text: Not everyone liked the music. Mean Machines Sega heard a 'lukewarm thrashy style'. VideoGames gave sound 5 of 10 and said skaters would rather listen to Schoolly D or Rocket from the Crypt.
